Subject: Order A48213 arrived damaged, need a replacement before Friday

Hi, my order A48213 (the 27-inch monitor, $329) arrived yesterday with a cracked screen and the box was dented on one corner. I already emailed on Monday and got no reply. I need a working monitor before Friday for a client presentation, so please send a replacement with express shipping rather than a refund. I am a Premium member. If this cannot be sorted by Thursday I will have to cancel my membership. Photos attached.
Priya Nair, priya@example.com
